scenarios.request: she admits the secret, so start wide and push in slowly on Mara
scenarios.why: The admission motivates the push: the room falls away as the secret comes out.

scenarios.request: the moment she realizes, creep in on Mara
scenarios.why: A creeping push is the realization arriving.

scenarios.request: pull back to leave Joon alone in the room
scenarios.why: Pulling away leaves him smaller and lonelier.

scenarios.request: orbit around the couple as they kiss
scenarios.why: Circling the kiss makes the world spin around them.

scenarios.request: crane up over the crowd for the ending
scenarios.why: Rising away from the crowd says the story is over.

scenarios.request: track alongside Mara as she walks
scenarios.why: The camera keeps pace beside her walk.

scenarios.request: whip pan to Joon when he speaks
scenarios.why: The whip is motivated by his line: the attention snaps to him.

scenarios.request: tilt up Joon slowly to show how tall he is
scenarios.why: A slow tilt up measures his height for us.

scenarios.request: follow Mara from behind through the market
scenarios.why: Behind her we go where she goes, into the crowd.
A full circle; "full" is not a full shot here.

scenarios.request: lock it off on a tripod and let the scene play
scenarios.why: Locking off lets the actors move while the frame holds still.
